title: Tenure Figma deep-clean: 445 fonts rebound, 182 fills/strokes bound, AAA moss-text fix, layer order fixed
summary: Full structural audit of both Tenure Figma pages. Layer list on Employee experience page reordered to canonical scroll sequence (01→07b→08→08b→08c→09→10 corrected). 445 Inter text nodes rebound to Text / caption mono (JetBrains Mono 12px); 116 fills and 21 strokes on Employee experience page bound to canonical Colour variables; 2 fills and 1 stroke on Brand and surfaces page similarly bound. AAA fix: 43 moss-fill TEXT nodes (✓ status glyphs + 'SEND AS WRITTEN' label) rebound from Colour/moss (#4a5d3a, 6.12:1 — AAA fail) to Colour/ochre link (#7a3d0a, 7.14:1 — AAA pass). All 13 promoted component instances (Stage banner, Console chrome band, Gherkin caption, Cost panel) confirmed intact across all stage frames; all 13 cost panel footnote configurations confirmed correct. Token gap logged: brand page contains 83 #ffffff and 1 #444444 fills not in Stratum palette — requires dedicated brand-page remediation pass.
